title: Boss: The Jumbled Label
story: A name label printer is broken. It should print names as Last, First with proper capitals. Find both bugs.
goal: Fix the program: for input asha rao it must print Rao, Asha.
starter:
name = input()
parts = name.split()
first = parts[0].capitalize()
last = parts[1].capitalize
print(first + " " + last)
hints: One method call is missing something that makes it actually run. Compare it with the line above.
After fixing that, check the order and the separator between the two names.
